content.user_title: Analyze Business Performance with BI Guidance
content.value_statement: Teams often struggle to turn metrics, dashboards, and research into clear business decisions. This skill structures analysis, KPI design, forecasting, and recommendations for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Designs KPI frameworks, OKRs, scorecards, and metric hierarchies for business goals.
Plans dashboards for Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Qlik Sense, and cloud analytics platforms.
Guides forecasting, cohort analysis, unit economics, retention analysis, and ROI modeling.
Structures customer, market, funnel, product, and industry-specific analytics work.
Explains data visualization, executive reporting, and stakeholder storytelling approaches.
Covers data quality, governance, privacy, and compliance considerations during analysis planning.
limitations: It provides guidance and analysis structure, not direct access to databases or BI tools.
It depends on the accuracy and completeness of data supplied by the user.
It cannot validate live dashboards, models, or forecasts without exported evidence.
It is not a substitute for legal, compliance, or certified financial advice.

use_cases.title: Build an Executive KPI Framework
use_cases.description: Define success metrics, data sources, dashboard sections, and operating review cadence for leadership reporting.

use_cases.title: Improve Customer Retention Analysis
use_cases.description: Segment churn patterns, plan cohort analysis, and turn retention findings into prioritized actions.

use_cases.title: Prepare Market and Revenue Models
use_cases.description: Structure TAM, revenue scenarios, unit economics, and sensitivity analysis for a new product decision.

prompt_templates.title: Define Metrics
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define business objectives and KPIs for this initiative. Include metric definitions, data sources, owners, and review frequency.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Dashboard
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a dashboard plan for these stakeholders and goals. Include sections, filters, alerts, drill-downs, and data quality checks.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Retention
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a churn and cohort analysis approach for this customer data. Include segmentation, hypotheses, model choices, and recommended actions.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Strategic Case
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop a business case for this opportunity. Include TAM, revenue scenarios, risks, sensitivity analysis, decision criteria, and executive summary.

output_examples.input: We need better leadership visibility into revenue, churn, and acquisition quality.
output_examples.output: A KPI framework with North Star metrics, dashboard sections, metric owners, refresh cadence, and decision rules for weekly operating reviews.

output_examples.input: Our churn increased last quarter, but teams disagree on the cause.
output_examples.output: A retention analysis plan covering cohort cuts, customer segments, product usage signals, survey evidence, root-cause hypotheses, and prioritized experiments.

output_examples.input: We are evaluating a new product line for a mid-market customer segment.
output_examples.output: A market sizing and revenue model outline with TAM, SAM, SOM, pricing assumptions, acquisition costs, margin scenarios, and key risks.

best_practices: Start with the decision, audience, and success criteria before choosing metrics or tools.
Document metric definitions, data lineage, assumptions, and known quality issues.
Translate findings into actions with owners, timelines, expected impact, and monitoring plans.
anti_patterns: Building dashboards before confirming stakeholder decisions and data availability.
Mixing exploratory metrics with official reporting without clear definitions.
Presenting correlations as causes without experiment design or supporting evidence.

faq.question: Can this skill build a live dashboard?
faq.answer: It can plan dashboard structure, metrics, filters, and validation checks. It cannot connect to BI tools by itself.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide business goals, audience, metric definitions, sample data, data quality notes, and current reporting pain points.

faq.question: Can it help with forecasting?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline forecasting methods, assumptions, scenarios, and validation steps for business planning.

faq.question: Is it suitable for sensitive business data?
faq.answer: Use sanitized or approved data when possible. Confirm your privacy, compliance, and internal data handling requirements.

faq.question: Can it replace a business analyst?
faq.answer: No. It provides structure and drafting support, but expert review is still needed for important decisions.
